$comment: The icons one of My agents may name in its file (`icon:`). The one list: the daemon refuses any other when an agent is saved (crates/loomwatch-backend/src/jobs.rs), and the app draws one for each and picks one from an agent's name when it saves it (ui/src/lib/library/roles.ts ROLE_ICON_IDS, checked against this list in draft.test.ts). An agent with no icon gets a plain mark.
